notes: This contract maps equal-time timestamped interaction delivery under Time Advance Request Available to the pinned 2025 service semantics. The pre-grant set is strict: a TSO at t_R is delivered after the grant, unlike a TSO with timestamp less than t_R. It does not generalize this result to TAR, NMR, NMRA, or Flush Queue Request, and it is not Requirements Lab validation or conformance evidence.

tests: cpp/tests/timestamped_send_interaction_retraction_catch2.cpp::Embedded TARA delivers a TSO at its exclusive request boundary only after the grant
requirements.notes: The TCK case sets the TSO timestamp and TARA request boundary to logical time 5, then verifies the grant callback precedes receiveInteraction. Its strict-less-than companion uses timestamp 5 and request boundary 6. The Catch2 reference is one HLA_EVOKED embedded implementation case and is not conformance evidence.
